clauses.title: Coverage Period
clauses.text: Coverage applies only to incidents occurring between the policy start date and policy end date as specified in the policy schedule.

clauses.title: Covered Vehicles
clauses.text: Coverage applies exclusively to the motor vehicle identified by registration number and vehicle details in the policy schedule.

clauses.title: Accidental Damage Coverage
clauses.text: Physical damage caused by accidental collision, impact, overturning, or similar accidental external events is covered subject to the terms, conditions, and deductibles of this policy.

clauses.title: Repair Settlement
clauses.text: For covered accidental damage repair claims, the insurer may consider the reasonable repair cost supported by a valid, itemized repair estimate from an authorized garage or repair facility.

clauses.title: Theft Coverage
clauses.text: The total theft or loss of the insured vehicle due to burglary, housebreaking, or theft is covered subject to the conditions and verification procedures of this policy.

clauses.title: Theft Evidence & FIR Requirement
clauses.text: A theft claim must include a certified copy of the First Information Report (FIR) lodged with the relevant law enforcement authority promptly following discovery of the theft.

clauses.title: Deliberate Damage
clauses.text: Any loss or physical damage caused deliberately, willfully, or with fraudulent intent by the insured person, vehicle custodian, or with their active connivance is strictly excluded from coverage.

clauses.title: Excluded Use
clauses.text: Loss or damage arising while the vehicle is being used for an explicitly excluded purpose, including commercial hire without endorsement, organized racing, pace-making, or speed testing, is not covered.

clauses.title: Fraudulent Information
clauses.text: A materially false statement or forged document intentionally provided in support of a claim may block settlement and requires mandatory investigator escalation and review.

clauses.title: Insured Declared Value
clauses.text: The Insured Declared Value (IDV) represents the agreed maximum settlement amount for total loss, constructive total loss, or unrecovered theft claims, less any applicable policy deductible.

clauses.title: Repair Claims & IDV
clauses.text: For ordinary repair claims, the IDV is not automatically the repair settlement amount; the reasonable covered repair cost is evaluated independently subject to policy depreciation schedules and conditions.

clauses.title: Notification Window
clauses.text: The insured should notify the insurer of any accidental damage or theft incident within 7 calendar days of the occurrence or discovery of the loss.

clauses.title: Late Notification
clauses.text: A claim notification received after the standard 7-calendar-day window requires a written explanation and investigator review rather than automatic rejection.

clauses.title: Accident Claim Documents
clauses.text: An accidental damage claim requires the submission of: (1) a completed Claim Form, (2) an itemized Repair Estimate, and (3) a detailed Incident Description.

clauses.title: Theft Claim Documents
clauses.text: A theft claim requires the submission of: (1) a completed Claim Form, (2) an official First Information Report (FIR) from law enforcement, and (3) a detailed Incident Description.

clauses.title: Evidence Quality & Consistency
clauses.text: Submitted claim documents containing material contradictions regarding incident date, damage particulars, or claimed financial figures must be reviewed and clarified before a final settlement recommendation is made.
